name: catalog-grids
goal: Present components and functions as responsive card grids while preserving revision links, evidence and responsive filtering.

evidence: Components and functions need neighboring card grids on desktop/tablet and one column on mobile. Component cards retain screenshots; function cards summarize contracts and link to recorded tests.

Existing catalog checks enforced a function table and only counted component cards. Extend the standardized catalog, navigation and responsive cases to assert both grids, contract summaries and revision-safe links.
